class.name: cho_controller_chain/JointImpedanceLaw
class.description: Chainable joint impedance law on the robot description's Pinocchio model: tau = M(q) (a_ref + Kp (q_ref - q) + Kd (v_ref - dq)) + C(q, dq) dq + g(q) on the effort interfaces. Exports a position, velocity and acceleration reference interface per joint; holds its activation pose when not chained.

class.name: cho_controller_chain/JointSpaceGenerator
class.description: JointSpace action (~/joint_space) as a reference generator: a Ruckig point-to-point trajectory written to the impedance law's reference interfaces; the last reference is held when no goal runs.

class.name: cho_controller_chain/TaskSpaceGenerator
class.description: TaskSpace action (~/task_space) as a reference generator: a Cartesian Ruckig trajectory turned into joint references by damped-least-squares differential IK and written to the impedance law's reference interfaces; the last reference is held when no goal runs.
